page.notes: Greek proverb is partly blurred; the final word λύκος and the accents are uncertain. "in-faustissimas" is hard to read in the scan. "Pailas" is printed as seen. The printed "Ecclef.)" was read as "Eccles.)". The parenthesis before "ex Apione" and after "Eccles." is printed unclosed in the first case. The "?" after "leo" has a space before it in print.
